thread.title: Royal Bank of Canada Reiterates “$185.00” Price Target for Apple (AAPL) - American Banking News

author: Abmn Staff
title: Royal Bank of Canada Reiterates “$185.00” Price Target for Apple (AAPL) - American Banking News
text:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) has been given a $185.00 price objective by research analysts at Royal Bank of Canada in a report released on Friday. The brokerage presently has a “buy” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Royal Bank of Canada’s price objective suggests a potential upside of 17.82% from the stock’s current price.
Several other research firms have also recently weighed in on AAPL. Morgan Stanley reiterated a “buy” rating and set a $247.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 26th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. restated a “buy” rating and issued a $272.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 10th. BidaskClub lowered shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a report on Wednesday, November 28th. HSBC downgraded shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $181.37 target price for the company. in a report on Sunday, December 9th. Finally, Needham & Company LLC reduced their target price on shares of Apple from $200.00 to $180.00 and set a “buy” rating on the stock in a report on Thursday, January 3rd. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-five have given a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $195.19.
